samples.label: TypeScript: nested templates
samples.ferrikiHtml:
interface Customer {
  name: string;
  tags: readonly string[];
}

export function describe<T extends Customer>(customer: T, prefix = "Order") {
  // A multiline comment checks comment state across a line break.
  const summary = `\n${prefix}: ${customer.name.toUpperCase()}\n`;
  return `${summary}${customer.tags.map((tag) => `#${tag}`).join(" ")}`;
}

samples.label: TSX: a generic JSX component
samples.ferrikiHtml:
type Entry = { id: string; label: string; active: boolean };
type Props<T extends Entry> = {
  items: readonly T[];
  onSelect: (item: T) => void;
};

export function ResultList<T extends Entry>({ items, onSelect }: Props<T>) {
  return (
    <ul aria-label="Results">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.id} className={`result ${item.active ? "active" : ""}`}>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => onSelect(item)}>
            {`${item.label} (${item.id})`}
          </button>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

samples.label: C++: templates, lambdas, and raw strings
samples.ferrikiHtml:
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <regex>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#define RESULT_PREFIX "Matched: "

template <typename T>
auto count_matching(const std::vector<T>& values, const std::regex& pattern) {
  return std::count_if(values.begin(), values.end(), [&](const T& value) {
    return std::regex_match(value, pattern);
  });
}

int main() {
  const std::vector<std::string> labels{"[tag] \"Ada\"", "skip"};
  const std::regex pattern{R"rule(\[\w+\]\s+"[^"]+")rule"};
  std::cout << RESULT_PREFIX << count_matching(labels, pattern) << '\n';
}

samples.label: Go: an HTTP handler
samples.ferrikiHtml:
package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "net/http"
)

type Reply struct {
    Message string `json:"message"`
    Count   int    `json:"count"`
}

func serve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    reply := Reply{Message: r.URL.Query().Get("name"), Count: 1}
    w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(reply); err != nil {
        http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
    }
}

samples.label: Rust: a typed parsing function
samples.ferrikiHtml:
use std::num::ParseIntError;

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Order {
    customer: String,
    total: u32,
}

fn parse_order(customer: &str, total: &str) -> Result<Order, ParseIntError> {
    let order = Order {
        customer: customer.to_owned(),
        total: total.parse::<u32>()?,
    };
    Ok(order)
}

fn main() {
    match parse_order("Ada", "42") {
        Ok(order) => println!("{}: {}", order.customer, order.total),
        Err(error) => eprintln!("Invalid total: {error}"),
    }
}

samples.label: HTML: embedded CSS and JavaScript
samples.source: München & café
samples.ferrikiHtml:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <style>
    .notice { color: #2563eb; }
    @media (width < 40rem) { .notice { color: #dc2626; } }
  </style>
  <body>
    <p class="notice" data-count="2">München & café</p>
    <script type="module">
      const rows = [{ name: "café", count: 2 }];
      const label = `Orders: ${rows.map(({ name, count }) => `${name} (${count})`).join(", ")}`;
      document.querySelector(".notice").textContent = label;
      console.log(/Orders:\s/.test(label));
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

samples.label: Astro: a complete component
samples.ferrikiHtml:
---
interface Props { title: string; items: readonly { name: string; count: number }[] }
const { title, items } = Astro.props;
const summary = `Items: ${items.map(({ name, count }) => `${name} (${count})`).join(", ")}`;
---
<section aria-label={title}>
  <h1>{title}</h1>
  <p>{summary}</p>
</section>
<style>
  section { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
</style>
<script>
  document.querySelector("section")?.classList.add("ready");
</script>
